advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make `test_allow_insecure_does_not_relax_certificate_verification` actually exercise the flag: build with `ca_bundle` set AND `allow_insecure=True` and assert the emitted `options['verify']` equals the CA path (not False), so a mutation wiring allow_insecure into verify-handling turns it red.
evidence: build_client_from_settings does not reference allow_insecure at all: `options: dict[str, Any] = {}` / `if settings.ca_bundle: options["verify"] = settings.ca_bundle` / `return jira_cls(server=..., token_auth=..., options=options or None)` (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira_datacenter/transport.py:88-91)

With ca_bundle="" the options dict is empty, so `options or None` yields None; `captured['options']` is None and the test's `captured.get('options') or {}` is `{}`, making `{}.get('verify', True) is not False` trivially True (test lines 213-227)
`assert captured.get('verify') is not False` — build_client_from_settings never passes a bare `verify=` kwarg, so this is `None is not False`, always True (test line 228)

ABSENCE: no mutation of allow_insecure-handling in build_client_from_settings could turn this test red, because allow_insecure is not an input to the function under test; the assertion is decoupled from the flag it claims to guard.
advisory.finding: The test `test_allow_insecure_does_not_relax_certificate_verification` is near-tautological: `build_client_from_settings` never reads `settings.allow_insecure`, and with `ca_bundle=""` it produces `options=None` (`options or None`), so no `verify` key is ever emitted for any value of `allow_insecure`. The assertions pass structurally and would not catch a regression that actually let `allow_insecure` set `verify=False`.
advisory.suggested_fix: Set `ca_bundle` to a non-empty path in the settings, then assert `captured['options']['verify'] == '<that path>'` (and never False); optionally add a second case with ca_bundle unset asserting 'verify' is absent from options — both then depend on the verify-resolution path rather than passing vacuously.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure the TLS-verification-failure test runs in a gating lane — either raise SSLError from a lightweight local stub instead of `importorskip('requests')`, or add `[jira-datacenter]` to the gating unit-test install so the test is not silently skipped.
evidence: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_config_settings.py:172: `pytest.importorskip("requests")` — skips the test when requests is absent
transport.py:108-109: "``requests`` ships as a transitive dependency of the ``[jira-datacenter]`` extra" — so requests is present only with that extra

_build-and-test.yml:230 (gating `test` job): `python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'` — the [jira-datacenter] extra (and thus requests) is NOT installed, so the TLS test skips in all three ubuntu + macOS cells

external-integration.yml:293: `python -m pip install -e '.[dev,jira-datacenter]'` installs requests, but external-integration.yml:326 runs only `pytest -m external tests/external/live_jira_dc` — the new unit test is not `-m external` and lives under tests/unit/, so this lane never collects it

ABSENCE: no gating CI lane both installs `requests` AND collects tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_config_settings.py, so the not-retried / ca_bundle-naming behavior this diff introduces is unverified in CI (the commit's mutation check ran locally only)
advisory.finding: The only test that exercises the fix's core behavior (SSLError classified before retry bookkeeping → TlsVerificationError, not retried, message naming ca_bundle) is skipped in every gating CI lane, because it guards on `pytest.importorskip('requests')` and the gating unit-test job installs only `.[dev]` (not the `[jira-datacenter]` extra that supplies `requests`), while the lane that does install that extra runs only `-m external` tests and never collects this unit test.
advisory.suggested_fix: Avoid depending on the optional `requests` install for a unit test of pure classification logic: define a local `class _SSLError(_t._connection_retry_exceptions()[0] if ... else Exception)` is fragile — instead make `_tls_verification_error` testable without requests, or install `.[jira-datacenter]` in the gating `test` job of _build-and-test.yml so `importorskip` does not skip.
